keyVerseDR: "He that is the greatest among you shall be your servant." (Mt 23:11)

level1.title: Be a Helper
level1.story: Jesus said some leaders liked to show off. He said, "The greatest among you must be a servant." Jesus wants us to be humble helpers.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, make me a good helper. Amen.

activity.title: A humble helper
activity.intro: Serve at home like Jesus asks.
items: Tidy our home crucifix or Mary statue
Set the table for my family

level2.title: The Greatest Is the Servant
level2.story: Jesus spoke to the crowds and His disciples about the scribes and Pharisees. He said to do what they teach, but not what they do, for they do not practice what they preach. They do things to be seen, love the best seats, and like to be greeted with honor. Jesus said, "He that is the greatest among you shall be your servant." Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
level2.keyLine: He that is the greatest among you shall be your servant.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus dislike showing off?
How can you serve without being noticed?
level2.prayer: Jesus, make me humble like You. Amen.

activity.title: Thank you, teacher
activity.intro: Write a thank-you note to someone who teaches you the faith by serving.

art.mainBrief: Jesus washing hands of the humble; child serving
